description:
Because:

* fxa-shared/tracing duplicates @fxa/shared/otel.
* The fxa-shared copy imports ../sentry, which blocks the sentry move.

This commit:

* Replaces fxa-shared/tracing with re-exports of @fxa/shared/otel.
* Deletes the old exporters, PII filters and mocha tracing tests.
* Ports the config and exporters tests to jest in libs/shared/otel.
* Keeps the profile-server otel.concurrencyLimit default at 10.
* Isolates the env var in the profile-server config spec.

Closes FXA-10674
